name: equals
description: Checks for equality between two participants and stores result in result
_note: The python equality operator will not throw for default types but it can evaluate incorrectly in some cases (floating point precision (0.1 + 0.2 == 0.3 is false), comparing NaN values returns false). So this should be included in the meaning of the primitive so that the engine can reason about it. Also, if a participant is an object that has its __eq__ method written incorrectly, it can also throw an error. However, this can also be reasoned about by the engine if the meaning of the participant is established. So I will expand the invariants soon and I am leaving a note here track my thoughts.
